title: Symmetric operadic mapping cylinder with relative restriction and active-slice comparison
statement:
Use the conventions of [def-coef-symmetric-operadic-family] for symmetric operads, families, coherent functors and active cocones, categorical equivalences of [lem-coef-joyal-model-structure], and cocartesian fibrations and edges of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. Let $P^\otimes$ and $Q^\otimes$ be small symmetric infinity-operads, let $O^\otimes$ be a symmetric infinity-operad in a containing universe, and let $P^\otimes\xrightarrow{u}Q^\otimes\xrightarrow{v}O^\otimes$ be maps of symmetric infinity-operads. All functor categories below are formed in a containing universe; the constructed cylinder is small in the universe of $P^\otimes$ and $Q^\otimes$. Set
$$S_u=(P^\otimes\times\Delta^1)\amalg_{P^\otimes\times\{1\}}Q^\otimes,$$
with its map to $N(\mathrm{Fin}_*)\times\Delta^1$ and its map to $O^\otimes$ given by $vu$ on the cylinder and by $v$ on $Q^\otimes$. There exist a small correspondence $\pi:M_u^\otimes\to N(\mathrm{Fin}_*)\times\Delta^1$, a family map $g:M_u^\otimes\to O^\otimes$, and a degreewise injective categorical equivalence $j:S_u\to M_u^\otimes$ over both bases, identifying the endpoint fibers exactly with $P^\otimes,Q^\otimes$. The projection $t:M_u^\otimes\to\Delta^1$ is a cocartesian fibration in the sense of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], and for every vertex $p$ of $P^\otimes$ the edge $j(\{p\}\times\Delta^1):p\to u(p)$ is $t$-cocartesian; thus the transport functor of $t$ along $0\to1$ is $u$, which is what it means for $t$ to be classified by $u$. Pullback along any simplex $\Delta^m\to\Delta^1$ is again a symmetric operadic family.

For every cocartesian fibration $q:E^\otimes\to O^\otimes$ which is a map of symmetric infinity-operads, let $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Fun}^{\mathrm{inert}}_{/O^\otimes}(P^\otimes,E^\otimes)$, $\mathcal B=\operatorname{Fun}^{\mathrm{inert}}_{/O^\otimes}(Q^\otimes,E^\otimes)$, and let $\mathcal L$ be the full subcategory of $\operatorname{Fun}_{/O^\otimes}(M_u^\otimes,E^\otimes)$ on family maps over $g$. Restriction along $j$ gives a map
$$R:\mathcal L\longrightarrow\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,\mathcal A)\times_{\mathcal A,\operatorname{ev}_1,u^*}\mathcal B$$
which lifts every simplex boundary, including dimension zero. It commutes exactly with the source restriction to $\mathcal A$. This is an assertion about the actual simplicial restriction, not merely an equivalence after passing to homotopy categories.

For every color $d$ of $Q^\otimes$, the source active slices have an equivalence
$$P^\otimes\times_{M_u^\otimes}(M_{u,\mathrm{act}}^\otimes)_{/d}\simeq P^\otimes\times_{Q^\otimes}(Q^\otimes_{\mathrm{act}})_{/d}.$$
It respects the source projection to $P^\otimes$ and, for every $H\in\mathcal L$ with $R(H)=(A,F,\eta)$, identifies the induced cocone of $H$ with the cocone whose component at $(p,\alpha:u(p)\to d)$ is $F(\alpha)\eta_p$, including its specified base cocone. Under these identifications $H$ satisfies the colorwise relative operadic left Kan condition if and only if these latter cocones are operadically $q$-colimiting. No colimit or Kan-extension hypothesis is imposed on $R(H)$.
